Command.Statement: WITH MEMBER [Measures].[Leaf] AS IIf([ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].CurrentMember.Children.Count = 0, "leaf", "node") MEMBER [Measures].[Ordinal] AS [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].CurrentMember.Level.Ordinal SELECT {[Measures].[Leaf], [Measures].[Ordinal]} ON 0, {Except({[ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].Members}, Descendants([ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].[REST_H], 1, SELF_AND_AFTER))} ON 1 FROM [ZCLVISIT]
